issues.root_cause: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX mirror paths exceeded Windows MAX_PATH (260): CPython silently skipped producer .pyc writes and every FF->CWP/ET child recompiled the full trees (compile() x122 per launch, 274-char cache path not written)
issues.resolution: fixed: short attempt-sibling cache root + 8.3 short code roots + cache-warming binding probe; measured max_pyc_path_len 252, company_wiki_pyc 98 (all imported modules)

issues.root_cause: seed_all launched 10 independent CWP CLI ensures (full interpreter+import each)
issues.resolution: fixed: one bounded seed_batch helper sequentially calling the same real ensure service; per-request request/response/receipt/source-ref/count records kept

issues.root_cause: case work could consume the whole 180s batch deadline so the mandatory final fresh source proof never launched (0 attempts) and oracle downgraded PASS to PARTIAL

issues.resolution: fixed: case window capped at batch.end-10s reserve; 30s/case and 180s/batch values/starts unchanged; proof runs after all changes

issues.root_cause: run_process leaked the child on non-timeout transport errors
issues.resolution: fixed: any exception kills/reaps the process tree
